# {{ c.name }}

> Dermatology and aesthetic clinic for skin, hair and nails in {{ c.address.locality }}, {{ c.address.city }}, {{ c.address.region }}, India, led by dermatologist {{ c.doctor.name }} ({{ c.doctor.qualifications }}; {{ c.doctor.registration }}). Appointments by phone or WhatsApp.

The treatment pages are general patient information reviewed by Dr. Kiruthika. They are not a substitute for a consultation. Fees are not published on this website; please contact the clinic.
